title: RyMeds
tagline: A high-reliability pharmacy management software streamlining inventory control, billing, and prescription tracking.
description: My first major software project designed to digitize local medical store billing workflows with zero training requirement.

screenshots.title: Counter Billing Interface
screenshots.caption: Fast item barcode scan & instant receipt generation

architecture: Python Modular GUI -> SQLite ACID Engine -> PDF Report Generator
database: SQLite relational tables: medicines (id, name, batch_no, expiry_date, stock_qty), sales, sale_items.
folderStructure:
rymeds/
├── src/
│   ├── controllers/InventoryController.py
│   ├── views/BillingWindow.py
│   └── database/schema.sql
└── rymeds.py
timeline: Late 2024: Architecture design & SQLite schema normalization
challenges: Calculating accurate expiry warnings while keeping billing speed fast during high customer traffic.
lessons: Software utility is measured by how effectively it solves immediate daily operations for non-technical users.
futureImprovements: Add GST tax auto-calculation and supplier purchase order generation.
